Looking at the revenue composition across the Marriott and Courtyard hotels, room revenues stood at INR19.6 crores in Q1 FY27 as against INR14.1 crores in Q1 FY26, a growth of 38.9%, while food and beverage revenues stood at INR11.8 crores as compared to INR10.3 crores, a growth of 15.1%.
